Course: On-load tap changers (OLTC) | Free Basic level – Brought to you by Transformer Magazine and Huaming

 

This is the first lesson of the OLTC course conducted on the basic level.

  • Hosted by:  Dr Raka Levi
  • Join us on March 5th at 2 pm CET for this interactive session and dive deep with industry experts!
  • Main Registration Site - Open Now: https://transformers-magazine.com/transformers-academy/oltc-course-lesson-1-on-load-tap-changer-basics/

In this event you will learn:

  • Foundational knowledge of load tap changers

Their purpose

  • The different construction types and operating principles of the patented process
  • Resistor and reactor constructions

 

 

Content of this lesson is fully vendor agnostic but it is sponsored by Huaming!

 

 

  • Sustainable Development Strategies for T&D, 9–11 April 2025 – Dubai UAE
  • Not familiar with tap changers? This comic will make it easy to understand!
